description: The ocean component of MIROC 7, COCO version 4.9, employs a tripolar horizontal grid with 360 × 256 grid cells. South of 63.33°N (360 × 208 grid cells), the grid is based on geographical longitude–latitude coordinates. North of 63.33°N, a generalized orthogonal curvilinear coordinate system is used, with two artificial poles located at (63.33°N, 60°E) and (63.33°N, 120°W). South of 63.33°N, the grid spacing is 1° in longitude and 1° × cos(θ) in latitude, where θ denotes latitude. North of 63.33°N, the horizontal grid spacing is approximately 50 km.  The grid consists of two staggered subgrids following the Arakawa B-grid configuration: - g010: Located at the center of each grid cell, where scalar variables (e.g., temperature, salinity, and pressure) are defined. - g011: Located at the northeastern corner of each grid cell, where both horizontal velocity components are defined.
